reviews.text: Requires Subscription. Should be disclosed.
Lifesaver. On trips this app has proved to be a lifesaver over the years with our kids!
Loop is too short. Does the job, but the loop of white noise seems to only be about 3 or 4 seconds long. My ear picks up on patterns pretty quickly which can make it harder to fall asleep

Piece of noise cake. As delightfully easy to use and swingingly spare to behold as one would wish a noise generator to be. The only such gizmo in my experience to have a ‘womb’ setting, which did seem to kindle my own primordial memories of inverted, astronaut-like drifting. This lil’ app has everything you need and has the austere UI of a Kubrick moment.

Best sleeping app out there. I can’t tell you how much I love this app rather it was me trying to sleep on a loud base. Or using it to sleep at home with three teenagers and there music. I’d suggest this app any day hands down.
WHITE NOISE SOUND MACHINE. BEST FREE WHITE NOISE APP!
Cool. Helps me go to sleep but most of the features are paid :(
Nice, but why so much RAM use?. Don’t get me wrong, it’s very nice. But why does it take 600 MB of RAM after starting and 1 GB after an hour or two? Surely this could be quite a simple little app?

One Glaring Issue. The way this app handles apple headphones is a monstrosity. If I want to use my phone during my lunch hour I have to make sure I quit the app or else the laptop and phone start wrestling for the headphones’ signal. 

Everything else the app is fantastic.
Sleeper. The sound selections and settings allow me to find just the right sound to put me to sleep.

Good app. I am able to sleep much better now. Stayed on throughout the entire night, it didnt drain too much of my battery at all, but it might depend on the device you use. 
Would recomend this app

Only white noise app for me. Love the noise choices as well as the customizable length of time. Had a white noise app that would crash (and the silence would wake me up!), this app does not quit until you want it to.
Best App Ever. So many sounds to combine and with other sounds and also play that sound by itself. LOVE IT! You need to try it!
Was Great!. For the last few weeks this app keeps on cutting out on me! Very aggravating! It was always perfect before😩

Battery Drain but worth it!. LOVE this app! It's helped me relax through some tumultuous times. Just be ready for a bit of energy drain if you run it all night. I love the ability to change up the sounds, and adjust the frequencies. It's always just right for my needs.

Best app for watch. Edit: too bad I cannot add more stars to my existing five star review - the developer read my review, and implemented the suggestions within a week!!!!

This is the only white noise app I’ve been able to find where the watch app is actually its own app, all the other watch apps seem to just be controllers for the phone app. And: the sounds are *very* high quality. The app is great as-is and worth the price. But on my wishlist for the watch app: - the ability to set favorite sounds on the watch, or have my phone favorites synced over, so that they can appear at the top of the list. - the ability to make/sync mixes so they can be accessed from the watch

best white noise for me. This worked to help me sleep in a city setting, in a foreign country, while I was away from my air cleaner. It never failed. I highly recommend it for someone who is used to a constantly running air cleaner noise.
Yeeeeereeer. Yeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee

Can’t see saved combinations on Watch. Not sure why this isn’t possible. Incredibly limiting. 
Gave feedback, but the thunder sound s very quiet even at max. Immediately covered by any sound over 1/3 volume. 
Would be a great app otherwise.

Best App for basic sounds. I’ve tried over 20 apps and keep coming back to this one it’s great for the basic sounds I would seek out on other apps + has the customization within the sound. My only complaint is the sound is not loud enough even with my phone at full volume (can still hear birds outside, a car door shut on the street etc)

Good quality masking sounds. Overall very pleased with this app, simple interface Smoothly fades into the noise, and even fades between sounds when you switch between them, though curiously "reset" volume jumps to 100%.

Some requests to improve it would include having the volume control be right alongside the sound selection bar, so adjustments can be made according to the changes in unwanted background noise and changes in music I may be playing alongside it. On the Mac, I would expect all dialogs to be able to be dismissed with the Esc key.
Close but compromises.. The ‘effects’ are global and not per voices so who cares about oscillation? Sure miss “Storm”. Nothing since comes close.

FANTASTIC!!!!. This is an AMAZING app!!!!! It helps me when I'm stressed, scared, and bored. It has helped me when I have meltdowns and it has helped me through my problems!!! It's a fantastic app!!! EVERYONE should get it!!! It's like mediating with your phone! Get it!!! It's awesome and helpful!!!

Best App Ever - 10 Stars. I cannot live without this app. I imagine you think I am exaggerating, but let me tell you: this app is worth 10 stars at the very least. It puts my infant daughter to sleep. It puts me to sleep. No one in this family can sleep without it. I can’t even tell you what my willingness to pay is for this thing. I would gladly sign over my paycheck. In addition, the customer service is incredible. I asked a question and Mark answered it immediately. Someone make this man rich if he isn’t already - he deserves it.
Clean Effective Software. Excellent, intuitive software - simple and straightforward with superior sound engineering.

Simple but yet so affective. Very good noise selection no adds and is very good there is no Sussy glitch’s or anything like that just a plain old white noise app with a nice amount of options and ya that’s it
Always available. I try it sounds for 4months it’s best for any Bluetooth help me sleep and wake up energy

Does exactly what we needed. Just downloaded but it seems I finally found a simple white noise machine with a timer. No crazy subscription or dark-patterns to get you to buy. 

Yes , there are extra sounds you can pay for, I might do it just to support the app if we continue like it!

Do wish we could just have a black background rather than the animation, but… I can just minimize the app too. :)

No longer free or any good. This app had all of its features available for free. It not only does not function well and the noises don’t loop well what so ever anymore, but you’re required to pay a weekly sub to get proper functionality?? Come on….I’ve used this app for a long time and I’m having to wait to fall asleep because I have to find another app that meets my needs. Extremely disappointed.
Took away free. Used this everyday for that reason. Definitely a shame will be deleting soon
GREAT!. Simple, easy and effective!

ONE NOISE ONLY?. One noise only doesn't work for our use.
you should have different choices.
Perfectly Simple. Exactly what I needed.

Finally! A free, customizable sound machine app!. I’ve been looking for a simple, free sound machine app, and imagine my surprise when every single stinkin’ app I tried either wasn’t remotely customizable or was going to cost me between $30 and $60 a year to use. Um, what? But apparently people are willing to pay that. FYI, you can buy an actual sound machine one time for the same price. Save yourself a buttload of money, people, and download this app!
❤️❤️. Amazing
The best!. No ads, no subscription, no crazy features, just a few different tracks and easy one click operation. Absolutely perfect app!

Best White Noise Out There. Totally customizable which is great because not all speakers sound the same. My neighbor snores like an ogre and the other one blasts russian soap operas so I think this app rocks
Life saver. My loud neighbours life saver 🤣 him and his noisy dogs barking every morning thankfully I can now sleep till I wake up naturally with the calming rain sounds 😁
Love it. Great help for people who practice meditation
Basic. Does exactly what it says on the tin. Sounds are good, obviously can unlock other sounds but I don’t need more sounds, there really are enough, something for everyone.
Super slick and just works. Simple and easy to use, while being surprisingly feature filled and powerful. My goto background noise app.

Fantastic sounds. I use this app to keep focus at work. I love that you can make your own sound combinations.
Nice work!

Looks amazing. Sounds even better.. Helps me focus and get into the flow whilst working. The design and navigation are slick, simple and intuitive. The library offers many choices of quality sounds, which you can combine and also modify using the audio effect options. The timer is helpful to remind you take breaks during the day or when going to sleep. The sounds fades out gradually when selecting new sounds or when the timer ends. As a plus, the app is available across all devices. Thank you and I look forward to hearing more sounds!
Amazing App. Really helps me to relax and get to sleep quickly. I use it every night.
Ronnie 5678. Does as advertised but found it a bit lacking being honest!
Okklhlllo. L
Get a great sleep. I love this smooth background noise. It puts me to sleep.
White Noise. Calming soothing sounds! Definitely helps me relax and sleep easier. Wonderful App. Thank You Raymond

Very …. TERRIBLE.
No noises emitted, and to pay for any of this would be even worse
Very good. I love this app but it only lets you chose a few hours to play I want to play it the whole night
absolutley amazing. i love this app soooo much!!!
